title: Speed Upgrade
text: Forge a swiftness rune with six resonance crystals. Automatic item intake and output run once every half-second; fluid transfer reaches 1,000 mB/s and a bucket takes one second.

Only accelerates existing transfers; it provides no automatic intake or output. Cruise orbs reject intake and output upgrades; speed boosts their fluid port and doubles movement after spell-core bonuses. Only one applies. Lava production and external item-pipe rates are unchanged.
